# Blue mascot expressions

Created on 2026-10-27 through the connected Higgsfield GPT Image 2.5 (Flare, high, 2k), using the user-approved blue A mascot as the identity reference.

- `greeting.webp`: welcoming wave.
- `thinking.webp`: hand at chin and three thought dots.
- `order.webp`: attentive order-taking with a notepad and pencil.

512 × 512px WebP, opaque white backgrounds. Full-resolution originals and generation provenance are retained locally under `design/one-shop-brand/motion-v1/`. These raster illustrations can be paired with CSS movement; they are not video clips.
